iterations.draft_explanation_full: The SHAP analysis (Figure 3B) indicates the relative importance of various features. The top features identified by their mean absolute SHAP values are VFA (0.0298), Butyrate (0.0304), and Acetate (0.0266). The feature importance ranking from the chart also highlights VFA, Butyrate, and Acetate as the top three features. The table evidence confirms the mean absolute SHAP values for these features, showing VFA having the highest value among the listed features in the table.
